title: docs(spec): say what the optional master did to the cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted notes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSzxEPRq7jQs3PC2g7nYmoh)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Fixes #30977

Claim: 6697140710 · Branch: `claude/project-thread-kujw5c`

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改注释。协议 18 的转换 `cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted` 和构建器 `forceCbpMasterDetailRequired` 的说明里，还写着「显式 `required: false` 的主表会被构建器和解析拒绝」，现在改成按 #30940 之后的实际规则来写。
- 为什么改：#30940（#30905 裁决 A）落地后，`controlled_by_parent` 对象唯一的 `master_detail` 写 `required: false` 是合法的可选主表；旧注释会让下一个改这个转换的人按已经不存在的规则推理。
- 对作者的影响：没有。转换行为不变：省略 `required` 仍补成 `true`，显式 `required: false` 仍不转换。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险，无行为改动；`apply` 与 fixture 形状一字未动。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 不在范围：文档和技能里的同类说法归 #30907（卡 3/3），本 PR 不碰。
- 发布：注释不进发布内容，打 `skip-changeset`。

## Stale sentences found, and how each was resolved

| # | Where (on `origin/main` 81deb548) | Stale claim | Resolution |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `conversions/entries/18/cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted.ts:56-58` | "An explicit `required: false` … The builder refuses it loudly … an author the builder would have stopped" | Rewritten: on the only `master_detail` it is the optional master (ADR-0055 §1 as amended, #30905 ruling A), kept by the builder and admitted by the parse, so the stored pass keeps it too; beside another `master_detail` the builder still refuses it. |
| 2 | same file `:66-68` | "a live author still meets the parse's refusal and its prescription" | Rewritten: a live author meets the builder's force through `ObjectSchema.create()` and `os lint`'s `relationship/master-detail-required` at `error`; a raw parse reads the omitted key as the optional master (the field default writes `false` first). |
| 3 | same file `:110` (fixture comment) | "refused by the builder, not converted here" | Now "the optional master, kept as written; not converted". Fixture shape untouched. |
| 4 | same file `:23-26` | "Ruling B made the parse refuse … without exactly one `master_detail` declared `required: true`" | True as history; kept, with one parenthesis noting ruling A's amendment and that the omitted key this entry converts is unchanged by it. |
| 5 | `data/object.zod.ts` `forceCbpMasterDetailRequired` docblock, closing paragraph | "the RULE — exactly one required `master_detail` … so a raw parse of a `master_detail` without `required: true` is refused rather than forced" | Rewritten: the rule includes the only `master_detail` as the optional master, and a raw parse is never forced (it reads an omitted `required` after its `false` default). The paragraphs above it already carry #30940's "⚠️ Amended" note and were left. |

Read and left as is:
- `summary` string (`:79-82`): every clause is still true ("an explicit `required: false` … not converted"), so it did not change, and no printed text moved.
- `migrations/entries/semantic/18.cbp-master-relation-tiers-retired.ts` (`:50-51`, `:69-70`, `:76`): its text on an explicit `required: false` is outdated, but #30940 added `18.cbp-optional-master-admitted`, whose `reason` says in so many words that it "supersedes what `cbp-master-relation-tiers-retired` and `cbp-master-detail-required-forced` say of it … everything else they say stands". The D3 record is superseded by a later entry, not edited, and its strings are printed to authors; left for that reason.
- `data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts` and `conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`: already updated by #30940; nothing stale.

- No changeset: comments only, nothing published moves (`skip-changeset`).
- Docs and skills untouched (#30907).
